subject.title: feat(plugins): add Control UI entry points

question: Should OpenClaw accept this new public plugin SDK/Gateway contract for top-level Control UI app-nav entry points, or keep the direction parked behind the broader Control UI contribution-slot RFC?
rationale: The PR adds a new plugin API, gateway RPCs, launch/session tokens, and iframe navigation behavior; that is a product and security-boundary choice beyond a routine bug fix.

options.title: Continue after hardening
options.body: Keep this PR open, require the fail-closed fixes and exact-head browser proof, then have maintainers approve the API and security model before merge.

options.title: Narrow back to RFC
options.body: Pause or close this implementation if maintainers want the broader Control UI contribution-slot design settled first in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/71736.

options.title: Reject core app-nav seam
options.body: Decline the core API and keep plugin UIs on standalone plugin routes or future ClawHub/plugin surfaces instead.

recommendation.title: Continue after hardening
recommendation.body: Keep this PR open, require the fail-closed fixes and exact-head browser proof, then have maintainers approve the API and security model before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter has recent merger history on the touched current-main paths and is the clearest available maintainer-routing owner for a product/security API decision.
